messages:
Maria G: forwarding — AcmeCo reported invoice INV-99877 was charged but their PO (PO-4821) is not printed on the PDF. they say the PO exists in their portal metadata. customer wants a reissued invoice or credit so they can apply internally. escalation to support+finance.
Taylor (Support): thanks — can you drop the customer's portal export or paste the billing API response for the invoice? first step: confirm whether the PO is on invoice.metadata or lost during PDF export.
Maria G: pasted JSON snippet in the ticket: `\n{\n  \"id\": \"INV-99877\",\n  \"amount\": 12400,\n  \"metadata\": { \"po_number\": \"PO-4821\" },\n  \"pdf_links\": [...]\n}` — metadata.po_number present, but PDF shows blank PO field.
Raj P: sounds like the PDF template mapping might be pulling from `line_items[].purchase_ref` not `metadata.po_number`. I've seen this when invoices were migrated from old billing export. quick repro: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-99877 | jq .` — check `line_items` section.
Emma B: confirmed via API: line_items array has no po field; metadata has PO. PDF renderer uses line_items[0].purchase_ref when present. bug or export mismatch.
Taylor (Support): proposed remediation path: 1) create a credit memo for INV-99877 for full amount; 2) create new invoice INV-99877-R1 that includes PO-4821 in the printable field (populate `line_items[].purchase_ref`); 3) send reissued PDF to customer; 4) coordinate with accounting for GL/tax tagging. Anyone object?
Oliver A: accounting needs: GL code (we'll inherit original), original invoice date, and tax breakdown. VAT unchanged. also need approval if credit > $10k — finance policy. INV-99877 is 12,400 so requires manager sign-off. I can approve once support confirms the reissue lines up 1:1 to original.
Maria G: customer prefers reissue rather than credit if possible (they need matching doc for internal ops). but they understand legal requirement for credit+rebill. asked for ETA.
Taylor (Support): ETA: runbook steps — `support/runbooks/invoice-reissue.md` — estimated 1 business day (credit ticket + new invoice generation + manual PDF check). I'll start the credit request now and tag @Oliver A for sign-off.
FinanceBot: accounting-ticket#A-1342 created for credit/rebill; assigned to Oliver A; linked to support-thread 1729456789 :white_check_mark:
Raj P: follow-up action for engineering: raise a PDF template mapping bug — field fallback should consider invoice.metadata.po_number if line_items[].purchase_ref missing. I'll open eng-issue and link here.
Emma B: added repro steps and minimal fixture to the ticket. saved sample invoice JSON and PDF render preview.
Taylor (Support): update for customer: "we're creating a credit and reissuing the invoice with PO-4821 embedded in the printable field. Estimated completion: 1 business day pending accounting approval." sent to customer at 12:48 PST :email:
Oliver A: approved accounting-ticket A-1342 at 13:05. proceeding with credit. once done, please ping me to close the loop and confirm VAT note on new invoice.
Maria G: thanks team. I'll keep AcmeCo updated. closing here once reissue PDF is delivered and customer confirms they can reconcile.
